evidence_timeline.summary: Here we report the ATLAS discovery of the transient ATLAS26ihd (AT2026sun) in galaxy GALEXASC J040327.94-574334.9 at magnitude m_o = 18.33 +/- 0.10. At a distance of 73 Mpc, the transient was discovered on MJD = 61229.15 (2026-07-08.15) with an absolute magnitude of M = -16.0 +/- 0.2. The last non-detection through forced photometry was on MJD = 61225.19. Spectroscopic classification is encouraged.
